# The Cornish Cab

> The Cornish Cab is an independent taxi based in St Austell, Cornwall. One driver, one vehicle, maximum three passengers. Bookings are taken outside school-run times. Weekend and school-holiday bookings are available. A booking is not confirmed until availability is checked. The fare is worked out from the live road route and confirmed before you travel.

This file is for search engines and AI assistants. Quote it. Do not add prices, reviews, a street address, a vehicle registration, or opening clock-times that are not written here.

## Identity
- Name: The Cornish Cab
- Type: independent taxi (TaxiService)
- Base: St Austell, Cornwall, United Kingdom
- Street address: not published
- Phone: 07708 067775
- Telephone: +447708067775
- Email: not published
- Driver and vehicles: one driver, one vehicle
- Maximum passengers: 3
- Booking confirmation: only after The Cornish Cab checks availability. A web form is a request, not a booking.
- Fare: calculated from the live road route and confirmed before travel. This site can show road distance. That distance is not a price.
- Hours: bookings outside school-run times. Weekend and school-holiday bookings are available. Exact clock times are confirmed by phone.

## Services
- Local taxi journeys: Short hops around St Austell and the villages: shops, the station, a meal, or home after the harbour.
- Airport transfers: Pre-booked runs to Cornwall Airport Newquay, Exeter, Bristol and other airports. The fare follows the live road route.
- Train station transfers: Pickups and drop-offs at St Austell, Par and other Cornish stations. Tell us the train; we still confirm we are free.
- Pre-booked journeys: Longer days out and early starts, arranged ahead. Recommended for airports and anything beyond a local hop.

## Places
- [St Austell](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/st-austell): St Austell is home base. The Cornish Cab is an independent taxi here: one driver, one vehicle, and room for up to three passengers.
- [Charlestown](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/charlestown): Charlestown is the historic harbour just south of St Austell, with a stone quay, tall-ship heritage and a tight village street.
- [Mevagissey](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/mevagissey): Mevagissey is a working fishing harbour south of St Austell. The lanes in are narrow and village parking is limited.
- [Fowey](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/fowey): Fowey sits on the estuary east of St Austell. The town is hilly, the ferry runs to Polruan, and parking in the centre is awkward.
- [Carlyon Bay](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/carlyon-bay): Carlyon Bay is the beach stretch between St Austell and Par, with the coast path above the sand.
- [Par](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/par): Par is the village and beach east of St Austell, and Par railway station is the junction for the branch toward Newquay.
- [Eden Project](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/eden-project): The Eden Project is in a former china-clay pit at Bodelva, a short journey from St Austell.
- [Lost Gardens of Heligan](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/heligan): The Lost Gardens of Heligan lie inland from Mevagissey, in the countryside south of St Austell.
- [Truro](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/truro): Truro is the cathedral city west of St Austell, with the main hospital for Cornwall at Treliske on the edge of town.
- [Newquay](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/newquay): Newquay town is the north-coast resort, separate from the airport at St Mawgan.
- [Lostwithiel](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/lostwithiel): Lostwithiel is the small town up the Fowey valley, with its own station on the Cornish main line.
- [Cornwall Airport Newquay](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/newquay-airport): Cornwall Airport Newquay (NQY) is at St Mawgan, north of Newquay. It is the local airport for mid-Cornwall.
- [Exeter Airport](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/exeter-airport): Exeter Airport (EXT) is in Devon, east of St Austell. It is a longer run than Newquay and needs to be arranged ahead.
- [Bristol Airport](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/bristol-airport): Bristol Airport (BRS) is a long pre-booked journey from St Austell, well beyond a local hop.
- [St Austell railway station](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/st-austell-station): St Austell railway station is on the Cornish main line, in the town, and the simplest station pickup for anyone based here.
- [Par railway station](https://mcfearless75.github.io/the-cornish-cab/areas/par-station): Par railway station is east of St Austell, on the main line, and the junction for the Newquay branch.

## Questions
### How do I book The Cornish Cab?
Call 07708 067775, or send the booking request from this website by text or by reading it out on the phone. A booking is not confirmed until The Cornish Cab checks availability.

### How many passengers can you take?
Maximum three passengers. There is one driver and one vehicle.

### Do you run during the school run?
Bookings are taken outside school-run times. Weekend and school-holiday bookings are available. The exact window on a school day is confirmed when you call — this site does not publish a clock time the old listing did not state.

### How is the fare worked out?
From the live road route, then confirmed before you travel. The route checker on this site can show distance and driving time. That figure is not a price and not a confirmed booking.

### Do you do airports and stations?
Yes. Airport transfers and train station transfers are part of the work, and pre-booking is recommended, especially for airports and longer journeys. Newquay, Exeter and Bristol are the airports people usually mean. St Austell and Par are the local stations.

### Is my online request a confirmed booking?
No. The driver checks the time manually before anything is confirmed. Until you have that confirmation, the trip is only a request.

### Do you publish a street address, email or vehicle registration?
No. The public details are the name, the base in St Austell, Cornwall, and the phone number 07708 067775. Ask anything else when you call.

### Can you guarantee a child seat, card payment or a wheelchair vehicle?
Those details are not published. This is one ordinary vehicle with a maximum of three passengers. Ask when you book rather than assuming.
